definitions.explanation: The act of pressuring or overwhelming someone through one's authority, power, or presence. Can describe both deliberate intimidation and the natural imposing quality of something.

examples.japanese: {威圧|いあつ}{的|てき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{威圧|いあつ}⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{圧倒|あっとう}された→圧倒される：15413_attousareru⟧。
examples.english: I was overwhelmed by his imposing presence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{威圧|いあつ}⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}えなかった→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I was intimidated by my boss and couldn't voice my opinion.

notes:
USAGE: Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form the verb {威圧|いあつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to coerce, to intimidate). Also commonly appears in the compound {威圧|いあつ}⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (sense of intimidation, imposing presence).

NUANCE: {威圧|いあつ} implies using power or authority to suppress others. Unlike ⟦{威嚇|いかく}→威嚇：09164_ikaku⟧ (active threatening), {威圧|いあつ} can describe a more passive overwhelming presence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {威圧|いあつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to coerce, intimidate)
- {威圧|いあつ}{的|てき} (intimidating, coercive)
- {威圧|いあつ}⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (sense of intimidation, imposing presence)
- {威圧|いあつ}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be intimidated - passive)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{威嚇|いかく}→威嚇：09164_ikaku⟧ (intimidation, threat - more active)
- ⟦{圧力|あつりょく}→圧力：12014_atsuryoku⟧ (pressure)
- ⟦{高圧|こうあつ}{的|てき}→高圧的：18279_kouatsuteki⟧ (high-handed, overbearing)
- ⟦{迫力|はくりょく}→迫力：14310_hakuryoku⟧ (force, impact - can be positive)
